title: Joining a Gym for the First Time in NZ — What to Expect and How to Choose
meta_desc: Joining a gym in NZ? Learn what to expect, costs and how to choose the best gym for you
intro: Joining a gym for the first time can be daunting, especially with numerous options available in New Zealand. With prices ranging from $10 to $50 per week, it's essential to consider your budget and fitness goals before making a decision. For example, a basic membership at Jetts Fitness costs around $14.95 per week, while a premium membership at Les Mills can cost up to $34.95 per week.

sections.heading: What to Look for in a Gym
sections.body: When choosing a gym, consider factors such as location, equipment, group fitness classes, and personal training options. It's also essential to read reviews and ask about contract terms, as some gyms may have a minimum commitment period, such as 12 months at City Fitness, while others may offer flexible, month-to-month contracts, like those at Anytime Fitness.

sections.heading: Trial Passes and Induction Sessions
sections.body: Many gyms in NZ offer trial passes or free induction sessions, allowing you to try out their facilities and services before committing to a membership. For instance, Snap Fitness offers a 7-day free trial, while Workout Wellington provides a complimentary induction session with a personal trainer.

sections.heading: Best Starter Gyms in NZ
sections.body: If you're new to working out or looking for a budget-friendly option, consider gyms like Jetts Fitness or Anytime Fitness, which offer affordable prices and flexible contracts. Alternatively, if you're willing to invest in a premium experience, Les Mills or City Fitness may be a better fit, with their wide range of group classes and state-of-the-art equipment.

sections.heading: Avoiding Overselling Yourself on a Contract
sections.body: It's crucial to carefully review the contract terms before signing up for a gym membership. Be aware of any additional fees, such as joining fees or cancellation fees, and make sure you understand the minimum commitment period. For example, some gyms may charge a $50 joining fee, while others may have a $100 cancellation fee if you terminate your contract early.
